description: R3.5 with the four-search budget stated explicitly in the aligned prompt

prompt.template:
Answer the question using the search tool. Search at least once. You may make at most four searches; after receiving results from the fourth search, you must answer and must not search again. Keep reasoning concise inside <think>...</think>. To search, emit exactly <search>query</search>; after each search you will receive <information>...</information>. If the visible evidence is insufficient to support every required hop and searches remain, search again. Finish with exactly <answer>final answer</answer>. Output no text outside the reasoning and the single search or answer action.
Question: {question}

versioning.change: State the existing four-search budget explicitly and reject smoke runs with more than 10% search-limit termination.
